scope: Actual local TCP server plus real approved Python subprocesses; synthetic model responses are fixtures, not inference qualification

prior_failures.finding: Store.artifact treated registry.artifact_ref dict as an object; root corrected return type before final integration.
Root added script-byte binding and atomic approval consumption; initial four direct script tests required updated binding parameters.
Slow-body and explicit port0 controls failed before repair.
Three positive ordinary-response tests failed with Bad file descriptor after final Content-Length read; peer corrected closed-response handling.

limitations: No installed language-model weights were exercised; model tool selection used a declared synthetic local HTTP fixture.
Desktop automation and GUI adapters were not exercised.
Tests executed on Linux Python 3.12; Windows/macOS startup, advisory locking and native worker cleanup remain unverified.
Windows Python-worker output polling is implemented but Windows descendant cleanup was not tested; scripts retain full host privileges.
FIFO tests are POSIX-specific and are bounded by an external 2-second subprocess timeout.
